Layers · Training stations

Every number on this plan is read from the module registry — hall counts, module counts and pipeline states are the pack's own values, not illustrations. The geography is schematic: bands show how the halls are grouped, not surveyed positions.

The interiors are functional programmes, not surveys. Each hall's rooms come from the eleven skill strands that hall actually teaches, and a room gains trade fixtures only when that trade's own focus line names them — a welding hall gets booths and fume extraction because its skills say so, and a drywall hall does not. No address data has been collected for any hall, so every plan carries an empty site block rather than an invented street address. The commissioning state on each plan is read from that hall's live-module share.

This is a plan of the network's halls grouped by district, not one campus site — each district band names the built campus it belongs to. Nothing on this plan is an accreditation or a union endorsement, and lesson content is unverified general practice pending authoring by practitioners.
